The CS50 keeps up with the demanding timelines of fieldwork, even when handling large survey datasets. Captivate 2027 adds AI-RTK for faster and more reliable GNSS positioning around obstructions, camera-based GNSS visual stakeout, and shared projects for efficient collaboration. polozky.perex: Esri’s CTO of Digital Twins spent years building the photogrammetry engine underneath ArcGIS Reality before Esri acquired his company outright.
polozky.telo: Esri’s CTO of Digital Twins spent years building the photogrammetry engine underneath ArcGIS Reality before Esri acquired his company outright. A conversation after this year’s User Conference covers what changed when Gaussian splatting arrived, why survey-grade accuracy still matters in an AI-driven capture environment, and what a working geospatial digital twin actually looks like in Zurich. Reality capture is no longer merely a source of contextual imagery; it is becoming an operational mapping process. polozky.nadpis: Should Smart Pixels Store Data—or Simply Reference It?
polozky.perex: Qassim Abdullah’s article on Smart Pixels in LIDAR Magazine prompted me to view the concept from a different perspective.
polozky.telo: Qassim Abdullah’s article on Smart Pixels in LIDAR Magazine prompted me to view the concept from a different perspective. Having spent more than twenty years working with building imagery and computer vision applications, I found myself asking a different question from the one I believe the original article was addressing. Rather than asking how much information a Smart Pixel should contain, I began asking what role a Smart Pixel should play in connecting imagery to the knowledge associated with a building.
